title: MIDI brand reskin
brief: Apply the MIDI brand pack identity to the interactive collage installation: pure #000000 and #FFFFFF, orthogonal geometry inherited from the mark's modular grid, zero radius, zero soft shadow. Each direction shows the three phone-client screens plus the projector operator panel, so the whole interface can be compared at once.

artboards.title: 01 · Bloques
artboards.tradeoff: Separation by channels instead of borders — the closest structural reading of the symbol. Risk: on a small screen the solid blocks compete with the photo.

artboards.title: 02 · Ficha
artboards.tradeoff: The interface as a printed technical form: 1px rules, tabular alignment, state carried by filled/empty squares because colour is unavailable. Risk: denser and more administrative, less physical.

artboards.title: 03 · Registro
artboards.tradeoff: Bands anchored to the screen edges with large numerals and 19-unit offsets, echoing the symbol's shifted top band. Risk: heavy border surface, the thumb competes with the content.
